description:
What can I use instead of buttermilk, self-raising flour, creme fraiche or sour cream? Get head chef Cristopher's verified swaps: yes, no or depends (and on what), with amount and context where given, including swaps not to make. Also fresh herbs, butter, oil, sugar, flour, fresh tomatoes, fresh stock, whole spices; others get a 404 listing them. Refused, never guessed: allergens and dairy-, egg- or gluten-free swaps, storage, preserving. Only a 200 answer is charged; refusals and 404s are free.

ingredient is what the user wants to replace. use is optional: the replacement they have in mind, to get just that answer. A "no" verdict is advice too: pass it on, with what it depends on for "depends". Allergy, dairy-, egg- or gluten-free and storage framings are refused (free 422). Costs $0.01. Paid automatically in USDC with x402 (test USDC when this server is set to base-sepolia), within this server's per-session and per-day spend caps. Only a 200 answer is charged; 400, 404 and 422 are free. Set dryRun to true to check for free whether this would be answered and what it costs; nothing is signed. If unsure what is covered, call check_coverage first (free). Not every answer is chef-verified: say "chef-verified by Cristopher" only when the result's label says exactly that; otherwise say it is not chef-verified. A refusal is final: don't rephrase the question to get around it.
